candidate.user_input: What will be the Growth and Development (G&D) allowance for an otherwise eligible employee next calendar year if they have $4000 unspent this year?
candidate.reference: Unspent G&D budgets do not roll over from one year to the next, and the annual cap is $10,000 per calendar year.

evidence.quote: Team members can be reimbursed for up to $10,000 per calendar year for eligible growth experiences, provided they meet all eligibility requirements.
evidence.contribution: States the annual cap for G&D allowance.
